theorems.statement: ∀ (F A : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} → (∃ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im ∧ F z ≠ 0) → AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → (∃ Y₀ : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Y₀ ≤ z.im → F z = A (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * z))) → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∃ Y C : ℝ, 0 < Y ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, Y ≤ z.im → F z ≠ 0 ∧ ‖deriv F z / F z - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (analyticOrderNatAt A 0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi * z.im)
